adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: An adolescent male with severe hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, ventricular preexcitation, skeletal myopathy, cognitive involvement, and maternal-line disease has the classic multisystem X-linked Danon phenotype.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Pompe can cause cardiomyopathy and myopathy but typically has a different age/severity pattern and no characteristic X-linked cognitive/conduction constellation; Fabry, sarcomeric HCM, and Duchenne each omit key components.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: Canonical Q0769 mentions Danon only as an incorrect Pompe distractor; it does not test Danon as a main construct. The current item therefore has no canonical main-construct overlap.
